title: Sarah Vaughan, the album and Bobby Shad
summary: He praises Sarah Vaughan and recalls the album and Bobby Shad's mistakes.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: Sarah... I love Sarah. Nothin' wrong with Sarah. I think Sarah is the greatest singer... Without being a Classical singer, I would say that Sarah Vaughan is the greatest singer alive today. And if I was a younger man, I'd be after her for that job. But I couldn't keep up with her. I'm too old. I think Sarah Vaughan is probably, to me... I made one album with her. Have you heard that album?
Oh yes, I have it.
Rowles - 85
What do you think of that album?
Oh, I like it very much.

I think that's one of the best albums she ever made. You know, they left about three tracks off that album. She sang "...[SINGS]...and yet..." She sang that. And then we did... We played...just the two of us, we played. Well, I forget what that was. That wasn't on it. They didn't put that on it. Bobby Shad?
Yeah.
Yeah, I've heard... I almost jumped over his desk at him.
Well, he sold that label to...
Because we did "Morning Star," and it was my tune with Johnny Mercer's lyrics, and he put down...
W.C. Handy or something?
W.C. Handy. Boy, he's a bad cat. I'd like to meet him again some time. I've got sharp toes.
Yeah, Bobby... He's out of the record business, I think.

I understand he's escaped with a whole bunch of stuff. Stop. I wouldn't believe it. I wouldn't doubt it, I mean. Well, some day, maybe, if I'm lucky, I'll see him -- if I'll know him. If I do that, there will be a little violence in the place. Because I think that's one of
Rowles - 86
the best records Sarah ever made.
Yeah, it's a lovely record.
Oh, she went wild on "That Face." And the way she sang "The Folks On The Hill"... WSHEW.
She's amazing, because her voice hasn't lost anything. On the contrary...
It's gotten better and better and better. She's the greatest on earth, I think. And that includes the Classicals, like Leontyne Price and all that. I still think Sarah cuts everybody.
Oh yeah.
And did you ever hear her play the piano?
Yes.

She'll play that piano. She knows. You could play World War... I've said this before. You could have World War Three going on; she'd still sing. Sarah Vaughan... God gave us Sarah Vaughan. He's taken a lot of them younger away. But he's left Sarah Vaughan. I think He likes to sit up there and listen to her. Because I'm afraid he thinks that when he gets her up there, nobody can...she won't have any help. She's too good! I don't know what he did with Tatum. He could put Tatum on a separate cloud and let him go. But with Sarah, I don't know.

I have a Japanese name for Sarah. It means "miracle."
